newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI allows forex trade new swap intruments.
newsitem.headline: India RBI allows forex trade new swap intruments.

text.p: India's central bank said on Friday it was allowing foreign exchange dealers the use of interest rates swaps, currency swaps and forward rate agreements to hedge their asset-liability porforlio.
In a statement, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said this followed a recommendation made by the Expert Group on Foreign Exchange Markets in India in this regard.
It said the use of the above instruments were subject to the following conditions:
- An appropriate risk management policy envisaging the use of the above instruments should be approved by the top management of the bank.

- The value of the hedge should not exceed the value of underlying amount and the maturity of the hedge should not exceed the maturit of the underlying. In other words, 'stand alone' transactions should not be initiated. However, in the event of a hedge becoming naked either in full or in part owing to shrinking of the portfolio and other changes in composition, such transactions may be allowed to continue till maturity.
